ledger.note: Searched trade press, the operator announcements, and the Energy Information Administration entries. Whistler mainline compressor expansion. Sources from 2022 and 2023 say only that Whistler gives access to South Texas and export markets in general. No source ties this expansion to LNG exports or a named terminal.

Searched trade press, the operator announcements, and the Energy Information Administration entries. Midland Lateral. Sources say the lateral connects Midland Basin supply to the Whistler mainline. The only LNG mention is a general one about the whole system, so the tie is left blank.

Searched trade press, the operator announcements, and the Energy Information Administration entries. Midland Lateral Extension into Martin County. A January 2022 announcement describes a Permian supply lateral and mentions export markets only for the whole Whistler system. No LNG tie to this project was found.

Searched trade press, the operator announcements, and the Energy Information Administration entries. Wildcat takes Anadarko Basin gas to a processing plant and the Tolar hub in north Texas. Press releases, Enable earnings material, and the Energy Information Administration entry name no LNG tie.
